title: Bercut IT Product Identity
description:
A series of logos and key visuals designed for Bercut's IT products. The project combines graphic design, brand identity and 3D visualization to create distinctive visual identities for digital products.

Each product identity includes a logo and a corresponding key visual developed from its graphic elements. The 3D compositions extend the visual language of the logos and are used across product landing pages, digital marketing materials, presentations and other brand communications.

additionalDescription:
Project Goals
- Update the visual identity: Introduce a modern, technology-driven yet reliable visual language.
- Build product recognition: Create distinctive product visuals and establish a clear visual connection between logos and graphics.
- Unify brand communications: Maintain a consistent visual style across all digital and print materials.
- Enhance visual appeal: Incorporate contemporary design trends, including 3D graphics and AI-generated imagery.

Design Approach
Individual logos for key IT products were developed using a set of fundamental shapes that define the visual style. This approach preserves a consistent graphic character aligned with the visual identity of the Bercut master brand.

Each product logo combines a custom graphic symbol with a typographic wordmark. Abstract geometric compositions reflect the products' key characteristics, including how they work, their advantages, and their applications.

The wordmarks use Halvar Breitschrift Bold. Unlike the monochrome Bercut corporate logo, the product logos feature two-color combinations to communicate specific meanings and emphasize elements of their graphic symbols.

The key visuals were created as 3D interpretations of the product logos. Their graphic elements were transformed into three-dimensional objects, with AI-generated textures and backgrounds added to create a futuristic aesthetic.

Project Outcomes
- Modern visual identity: An updated visual style that gives the brand a contemporary appearance in its competitive environment.
- Brand recognition: A consistent graphic language that visually connects the company's products.

Tools & Technologies
- Blender: 3D modeling and rendering.
- Flux: AI-generated textures.
- Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop: Logo design and final composition of key visuals.
